description: Source code implementing semaphore operations for Zephyr RTOS using CMSIS RTOS v2 API, including creation, acquisition, release, deletion, and name retrieval of semaphores.

methods.name: osSemaphoreNew
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new semaphore object with specified maximum and initial counts.

methods.name: osSemaphoreAcquire
methods.description: Waits until a semaphore becomes available or timeout occurs.

methods.name: osSemaphoreGetCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of the semaphore.

methods.name: osSemaphoreGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the semaphore.
